du_enchant_browser.title: Enchantment Library
du_enchant_browser.search_hint: Search by name, mod or ID...
du_enchant_browser.mode_tip: Find any selected: stops when one filter matches. Find all selected: requires every filter on the same villager. Advanced filters preserved: %s
du_enchant_browser.original_tip: Opens Auto Cycler's advanced filters. Unsaved changes on this screen will be discarded.
du_enchant_browser.save_error: Could not save; check the log.
du_enchant_browser.empty: No results. Change the category or clear the search.
du_enchant_browser.category_hint: Choose the equipment for this book.
du_enchant_browser.technical_details:
Mod: %s
ID: %s

The list follows the enchantments allowed in this world's trades, excluding curses. Custom server rules may change availability.

Names and descriptions use translations supplied by the installed mods.
du_enchant_browser.missing_description: This mod did not provide a description. Check the book in JEI or the mod's guide.
du_enchant_browser.save_tip: Applies your selected filters. Then use the normal Auto Cycler controls to start cycling.
du_enchant_browser.apply_hint: Select books, then click Save and apply.
du_enchant_browser.price_tip: Maximum payment items per trade (usually emeralds). Existing filters keep their configured payment item.
du_enchant_browser.favorites_tip: Use the stars to save favorites. This button switches between all books and favorites.
du_enchant_browser.clear_warning: Unselect every library book? Advanced filters are preserved. The change is only applied when you click Save and apply.
du_enchant_browser.price_payment_tip: Maximum %s per trade. Existing filters keep their configured payment item.
du_enchant_browser.library_error: Could not save the library; see the log.
du_enchant_browser.save_list_tip: Stores selected books, levels, prices, payment items and match mode. Does not change active filters.
du_enchant_browser.invalid_list_name: Enter a name with 1 to 48 characters.
du_enchant_browser.lists_hint: Save your selection or load a list. Then review and apply the filters.
du_enchant_browser.lists_empty: No saved lists yet. Select your books and name the selection.
